Introduction. Simple tunic yellow is an armor piece which can be purchased from Hildir for 350 Coins. This item will be in the merchant's assortment only after returning Hildir's brass chest.

Notes. • Wearing this armor decreases stamina usage while using the Hammer, the Hoe, the Cultivator, and the Serving tray by 20%.
